decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Dragapult vs Garchomp turn 1. Dragapult could be physical or special. Scaleshot is super effective and boosts speed. But if dragapult outspeeds and uses Dragon Darts/Dragon Pulse, garchomp takes damage. Scale Shot gives +1 Spe after, helping.

If Dragapult is scarf special, it could OHKO or heavily damage. Let's consider: Scaleshot is 2-5 hits at 25 BP, SE = 50 BP effective per hit, ~2.5x damage on average vs neutral. It's a good offensive option and boosts speed. But Garchomp with roughskin + lifeorb... Stealth Rock helps the rest of the team.

If Dragapult switches out to toxapex or gholdengo, Stealth Rock is better value. But if dragapult stays in and attacks, garchomp takes damage. Setting rocks turn 1 risks taking a hit but is generally fine — garchomp is bulky enough.

Actually, going for scaleshot is aggressive; if dragapult is special-attacking with Dragon Pulse, garchomp survives likely (183 HP, SpD 107). Let's think about damage: level 50 Dragon Pulse from160 SpA dragapult: ~40-50% to garchomp probably. Then scaleshot KO's or nearly.

I'll go with stealthrock — standard safe play. But if dragapult uses Dragon Darts (physical) it could hurt. Hmm.

Actually with lifeorb and roughskin, sponging a hit isn't great. Stealth Rock is valuable against their team (chandelure, dragapult, gholdengo, whimsicott, palafin — all weak or neutral). Setting rocks turn 1 when dragapult might just use U-turn or set up is fine.

Alternative: Scaleshot forces damage now. If dragapult is a special set with Thunderbolt/Flamethrower, garchomp survives and scaleshot does good damage.

I think Stealth Rock is the safer standard play and gives lasting value. Let's go with it.

I'll go Kowtow Cleave — reliable super-effective damage, kills Dragapult if it stays.
